summary: Defines instance digests for HTTP, letting a message carry a checksum of the whole resource rather than just the body piece sent, and allowing more than one digest algorithm. It extends the idea of Content-MD5. It was replaced by RFC 9530.

eli5.summary: A checksum is a fingerprint for a file. This lets a web server send a fingerprint of the whole file even if you only got a part of it. It has been replaced by RFC 9530.
